fullDescription: Cinematic high-tech design system for agentic AI and enterprise SaaS platforms. Features a deep dark mode aesthetic ('Ink' #030509) with vibrant lime (#ccff00) and electric blue (#2f80ff) accents. The style utilizes glassmorphism, editorial display typography (Cabinet Grotesk), and developer-centric monospace details (JetBrains Mono). It is ideal for showcasing real-time simulations, autonomous workflows, and complex data orchestration with a premium, futuristic feel. The layout includes grid-based simulation viewports, animated status indicators, and sleek glass-card components with subtle grid overlays.

structured.summary: A premium cinematic UI for AI orchestration, blending deep space backgrounds with high-contrast lime accents. It features a technical yet elegant aesthetic using heavy display fonts, glassmorphism containers, and motion-heavy interactive elements like custom cursor trails and live status animations.

style.description: The style essence is 'Cinematic Tech.' It uses a core background of #030509 with text in #ffffff and muted grays (#aab1bf). Accent colors include Lime (#ccff00) for primary calls to action and status, and Reign Blue (#2f80ff) for branding. Typography pairs the heavy-weight Cabinet Grotesk for headlines (800-900 weight) with Plus Jakarta Sans for UI and JetBrains Mono for technical metadata. Borders are consistently thin (1px) with low opacity (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) to create a glass-like layering effect.
style.prompt: Create a design system using a dark theme with background #030509. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (900 weight) for hero headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text. Incorporate 'JetBrains Mono' for all technical labels and tracking-heavy metadata. Primary accent color is Lime #ccff00 (glow: 0 0 30px rgba(204,255,0,0.3)), secondary is Reign Blue #2f80ff. Apply glassmorphism to cards using background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(16px), and 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Include a subtle grid pattern background using 60px size and 0.08 opacity. Buttons should have a border-radius of 999px or 1.5rem. Animations must use cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) and include floating effects (translateY -8px) and gradient text transitions from #2f80ff to #ccff00.

layout_and_structure.description: Modular structure focused on a central cinematic viewport. The layout moves from a minimal fixed header into a large-scale hero section, followed by a wide-format simulation dashboard that features a three-column internal grid (Trace, Stage, Metrics). Below the dashboard, interactive tabs allow for context switching, followed by dual-path CTA blocks and a minimalist monospace footer.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header (h-24) with #030509 background at 80% opacity and backdrop-blur-md. Logo on left featuring a rounded-xl blue icon (#2f80ff) with a crown glyph. Right-side navigation uses JetBrains Mono (12px, uppercase, 0.3em tracking) for links and a rounded-full Lime button for the primary CTA. Border-bottom is 1px white/5.

Center-aligned hero. Top label in Lime #ccff00 with 0.3em letter-spacing between two horizontal lines. Headline in Cabinet Grotesk (text-7xl to 8xl) with tight leading (0.95). Subtext (text-xl, color #aab1bf) limited to 3xl max-width. Background includes soft radial gradients of Blue (top-left) and Lime (bottom-right) at 10% opacity with 120px blur.

Large glass-card (min-height 640px) with 2.5rem border-radius. Top bar mimics a browser with red/yellow/green traffic light icons and a centered monospace URL bar. The internal grid is 3 columns: Left (280px) for a 'Runtime Trace' list with active/inactive states; Center (flexible) for the 'Stage' containing the main visual simulation; Right (260px) for KPIs and active integration icons. The center stage includes an interactive lime cursor (#ccff00) with a trailing particle effect.

Horizontal row of buttons with 1rem gaps. Each button features a 2-rem border-radius, background of white/5, and an iconify-icon. Active state uses a lime border (lime/30) and a subtle lime glow. Hover state triggers a translateY(-2px) move and increased glow.

Two high-contrast cards side-by-side. Primary: Lime #ccff00 background with #030509 text, heavy shadow. Secondary: Transparent background with white/20 border. Both use 1.5rem border-radius and bold 18px text.

Minimalist layout with a white/5 top border. Left side features a small logo and copyright in monospace. Right side features a horizontal list of links in JetBrains Mono (11px, uppercase, wide tracking) in muted gray.

special_ui_components.description: A custom pointer for simulation areas that leaves a temporary trail.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a 12px circular div (#ccff00) with a drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ccff00). It should follow mouse coordinates within its parent container. As it moves, it should spawn 6px 'trail' divs with 0.4 opacity that fade out and remove themselves from the DOM after 500ms.

special_ui_components.description: Vertical progress indicator items used in the dashboard sidebar.
special_ui_components.prompt: Design 80px tall cards with 1px white/10 borders. Active state: white/5 background, 100% opacity, blue (#2f80ff) label. Inactive state: 40% opacity, no background, muted gray label. Each item shows a monospace timestamp (e.g., 00-15s) above a bold, uppercase phase title.

structured.special_notes: MUST use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for impact; if unavailable, use a very heavy weight Inter or Arial Black. DO NOT use rounded corners smaller than 1rem for main components; stay between 1.5rem and 2.5rem for the 'cinematic' feel. MUST include the 60px grid overlay on glass cards to prevent them from looking flat. MUST maintain the high contrast between the #030509 background and the #ccff00 accents to preserve readability and accessibility.
